generation.method: Deterministic template composition and date normalization from the authored baseline, with four distinct hotel-service situations each month.

provenance.statement: All people, personal facts, hotel policies, requests, commitments and represented event dates are authored fiction. Each entry is an independent reset seed, not continuous guest history. November 2026 public reference facts are kept separately in evidence/reference/sources.json; they are not imported guest data.
provenance.future_dates: Records dated after collection are synthetic prospective scenarios, never observations of actual future events.
provenance.record_identity: scenario_id plus record_type plus record id; App-local IDs are intentionally reused only across isolated runs.
